The bounded observation (ev_ffDTQ4BjKbvn) confirms that adding one replica drains one shard of the queue without changing error signatures, and the approved capacity ceiling is 11 replicas. There are no new releases or flag changes during the incident (ev_QuJkba5Q8azK), ruling out deployment regression or feature flag recursion. No dependency failures or database waits were found (ev_nejRa6woED4b). Therefore, the root cause is traffic capacity exhaustion, and the remediation is to scale the service up to the approved ceiling of 11 replicas.
